object_mapping.input: Finite nonnegative U acting forward on columns, row/column sums<=1, killed row/columns K zero, i outside K; trial real h_i=1,h_K=0,||h||infinity<=M; real c
object_mapping.output: Interval for positive-step return q to i before killing; not the whole committor vector
object_mapping.bridge: With row-transition T=U transpose, the hitting potential f of singleton i before K gives q=sum_j T[i,j] f[j], f[i]=1. The stationary backward committor is not silently identified with U transpose/counting adjoint.

required_certificates: Check both residuals mu+=Uh-h+c*eta and mu-=Utranspose*h-h+c*eta
For BOTH signs and every z vanishing on K with ||z||infinity<=1+M, certify |mu_d dot z|<=X sqrt(z dot(I-U)z)+epsilon; mere sampled z or scalar residual is not a certificate
Construct an interval-safe delta=|h dot mu+|+2X^2+2epsilon, then intersect [1-c-delta,1-c+delta] with[0,1]
No almost-sure killing assumption; exact oracle must handle unreachable closed classes by the minimal nonnegative hitting solution
proposed_prediction: After separate executable registration/freeze of eligible synthetic fixtures and held-out cases, every qualified interval contains an independent exact rational return probability, at least one held-out eligible case has width<=1e-3, and total construction/certificate/solve time and peak memory are no worse than the strongest old qualified error-certificate baseline to claim incremental workflow benefit. Containment alone is a consistency check; an exact old solve already sufficient is a valid no-benefit outcome.
threshold_provenance: 1e-3 is a proposed engineering trial threshold chosen before fixture outputs, not a requirement of deeptime or a theorem consequence. Benchmark/held-out inputs and timing windows still need registration; no target executed.
fair_baselines: Exact rational harmonic solve after full SCC/reachability preprocessing, selecting minimal nonnegative solution
Existing forward/backward committor equations on admitted inputs
Strong old energy/resolvent/residual error certificate on the SAME accessible component and norm; compare total costs, not a deliberately singular global-gap baseline
admission_before_execution: Specify deterministic trial-potential construction and complete cost of BOTH dual certificates without using the exact oracle for free
Freeze fixtures, seeds if any, held-out split, precision, operations, time/memory and success/failure rules in a separate executable spec
Check transformed real consumer input or label fixtures synthetic; source API example fails the matrix contract
Do not download a large package/model or claim domain transfer from a finite interface check
resource_proposal: Before executable freeze, use only small finite synthetic matrices, no dependency installs; choose final resource cap and count all preprocessing/certificate costs before target outputs. This plan authorizes no unregistered numerical target.
